about: iOS copy changes Android ships before the iOS sources the tables are generated from have them. scripts/import-ios-strings.py applies each while iOS still has the text under "ios", says when iOS has landed one (delete it then), and refuses when iOS has anything else. Never type these into strings.*.json.

changes.change: Booking confirm card (IS): the service row says Þjónusta, not Tími, the Time row's word (lifepass-ios: the feat/booking-layout-update-prompt follow-up)
Venue hours kicker: Usual hours / Almennur opnunartími, not This week / Þessa viku, key venue.hours_this_week to venue.hours_usual (lifepass-ios feat/venue-usual-hours-is-description bb92f16)
Class room row: Room / Salur, key booking.room.label (API 0.44.0; lifepass-ios feat/member-feedback, the app version after 3.1.0)

Venue rating numbers: the stars' count is every rating, 4.6 · 23 ratings / 4,6 · 23 einkunnir (venue.ratings.count.one/.many), and the Equipment / Cleanliness averages, Tækjabúnaður / Hreinlæti (venue.ratings.equipment, venue.ratings.cleanliness) (API 0.46.0; lifepass-ios feat/member-feedback, the app version after 3.1.0)

Save hikes and sights: the heart's name, its failures, and Favourites' third section Hikes & sights / Útivist (favourites.heart.save, .saveFailed, .removeFailed, favourites.tabs.outdoors, favourites.empty.outdoors.title/.body, favourites.card.removeNamed) (API 0.45.0; lifepass-ios feat/member-feedback, the app version after 3.1.0)
